row.title: D1 cap spent made the GitHub App token unreadable
row.body: Measured 2026-11-18: watchdog run 44373626830 logged 'read main 401' four times because the credential row could not be read once the daily D1 allowance was spent. Evidence: auth memo test, freetier alert test and test_pm publish test pass.
